# Scramasax: paint + material mask view atlas

Scope: image generation only. Write ONLY into `level_generation/props/items_mm9_claude/codex_tex/d10007/`. Do not edit any other file, do not run builds.

Inputs (attached):
- `paint_mask_guide.png`: 1536x2048 transparent sheet, three columns by FOUR rows of 512x512 cells. Rows 1-2 and rows
  3-4 hold the same five grey orthographic renders of the exact 3D model: FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty.

Task: use your built-in image generation tool to paint the guide sheet. Output ONE PNG with a transparent background
and a 3:4 canvas (1536x2048 or the tool's nearest 3:4 size), the same layout, each object in exactly the same position,
size and outline as its grey guide. Paint the grey objects only; never redraw, enlarge, move or redesign them.

- Rows 1-2 (PAINT): the unlit base colour of the item on each view: Faithfully reconstruct the exact MM9 Scramasax from the isolated and mechanically rotated PCX references as an MM6-MM8-style inventory sprite. Repaint the same object; do not redesign it. Preserve the very narrow, straight dark-gray single-edged blade and pale cutting edge, tiny flat yellow-brass guard, distinctive grip made from alternating pale-silver and dark bands, and small reddish-copper faceted pommel. Keep its unusually lean utilitarian silhouette. Render one complete vertical sword with restrained late-1990s pre-rendered realism and genuine transparent alpha. No broad blade, leather g.
- Rows 3-4 (MATERIAL MASK): the same five silhouettes filled with FLAT pure colours only, no shading, no texture, no
  outlines, no antialiased colour blends inside:
  - pure red #FF0000: every metal part (steel, iron, chain mail, gold, silver, bronze, copper, brass)
  - pure green #00FF00: every leather part (straps, padding, hide, suede) and fur
  - pure blue #0000FF: every cloth part (tabards, quilting, linings, cords, ribbons) and hair
  - pure yellow #FFFF00: every matte non-metal solid (wood, bone, horn, stone, parchment, paper, wax)
  - pure black #000000: every gemstone, crystal, glass, pearl, enamel or liquid seen through glass
  Every pixel of each silhouette gets exactly one of these colours; nothing outside the silhouettes.
- `design_reference.png`: the approved HD painting or master of the item, the material and detail reference.
- `icon_x8.png`: the original game icon (magenta is background), the colour reference.

Object: Faithfully reconstruct the exact MM9 Scramasax from the isolated and mechanically rotated PCX references as an MM6-MM8-style inventory sprite. Repaint the same object; do not redesign it. Preserve the very narrow, straight dark-gray single-edged blade and pale cutting edge, tiny flat yellow-brass guard, distinctive grip made from alternating pale-silver and dark bands, and small reddish-copper faceted pommel. Keep its unusually lean utilitarian silhouette. Render one complete vertical sword with restrained late-1990s pre-rendered realism and genuine transparent alpha. No broad blade, leather g

- Facets, engravings, scrollwork and inner swirls follow the design reference, scaled to each view.
- Keep every gap and opening exactly as in the guide and fully transparent.
- Unlit base colour only: no lighting, no cast shadows, no ambient occlusion, no hot highlights or reflections, no
  glow halo, sparkles or aura outside the silhouette, no ground, no outlines, no text.
- The empty cells (column 3 of row 2 and row 4) stay empty and transparent.

Save the generated image (copy the file the tool produced) to `level_generation/props/items_mm9_claude/codex_tex/d10007/paint_mask_raw_v1.png` and write
`generation_paint.json` (prompt, inputs with sha256, original output path, output, size). At most one corrective
regeneration, only if the silhouettes or layout are clearly wrong.

Use case: precise-object-edit. First input is the exact edit target guide. Second is design_reference, third is icon_x8 (ignore magenta). Preserve all TEN silhouettes precisely. The instruction about one vertical sword describes the item only; the output must be the complete guide atlas with all views. All parts of this sword including dark grip bands are metal: bottom two rows must be solid pure red #FF0000. Preserve transparent empty cells and background. Output 1536x2048 PNG.
CORRECTION: Previous attempt widened side-view blades and introduced ragged red streaks outside the material masks. Strictly trace original guide alpha boundaries, especially hairline horizontal edge-on blades. No new blade thickness. Bottom silhouettes are clean flat red shapes exactly matching guide, with absolutely no stray pixels, noise, streaks, or outlines. Preserve original guide shape rather than silhouette of the design reference. Top views use subdued unlit base color, no hot specular highlights.
